invariants.rationale: 'actor' is assumed to be of type Actor or null based on its usage (instanceof, getWidth()).
'style' is used to access subfields ('style.background', etc.), so it must be non-null for this code to proceed safely.
The left, right, and min widths for the background drawable are likely non-negative, as negative widths would not make sense for layout.
If scrolling in Y is enabled, at least one of the scrollbar or knob should be present to permit proper rendering and computation.
